trap.label: pronome repetido
trap.wrong: The man who I saw him is my boss.
trap.right: The man who I saw is my boss.
trap.why: Em português coloquial repetimos o pronome ("o homem que eu o vi"). Em inglês, o pronome relativo já é o objeto.

opts: Rio which is hot is lively.
Rio, that is hot, is lively.
Rio, which is hot, is lively.

mcq.q: Complete: The woman **___** called is my aunt.

opts: The film that we saw it was long.
The film that we saw was long.
The film who we saw was long.

mcq.q: Em qual frase that é impossível?

fix.wrong: The girl who I met her is kind.
fix.right: The girl who I met is kind.

fix.wrong: The song which she sang it was lovely.
fix.right: The song which she sang was lovely.

fix.wrong: My brother that lives in Rome called.
fix.right: My brother, who lives in Rome, called.

rewrite.prompt: Una com whose: “I met a boy. His dog is huge.”
rewrite.answer: I met a boy whose dog is huge.

rewrite.prompt: Una com vírgulas: “Anna is my cousin. She lives in Paris.” (who)
rewrite.answer: Anna, who lives in Paris, is my cousin.

rewrite.prompt: Una com which: “London is huge. It has many parks.”
rewrite.answer: London, which has many parks, is huge.
